domiciliary.note: Min 3 consecutive days; no room/unable to reach hospital

ambulance.note: Road ambulance ₹2,000 + air ambulance ₹2.5L per hospitalisation (emergency only)

modern_treatments.note: Robotic surgery ₹1L/claim cap on most procedures
